description: Connects a subdomain (for example photo.example.com, set with the host parameter) to a photographer website built with Kadrafolio and hosted on Vercel: one CNAME to the target Vercel assigns to the Kadrafolio project. For the apex domain use the website template.
variableDescription: cname and pool: label and pool number of the Vercel CNAME target from the domain configuration of the Kadrafolio project (e.g. d1d4fc829fe7bc7c and 017 for d1d4fc829fe7bc7c.vercel-dns-017.com).
